messages:
olivia: noticed a 3-4x p90 spike on sm90 nodes after yesterday's cutlass toggle flip. looks correlated with mixed FP8/4bit routes when kv cache load is hot. attaching quick traces i ran.

sam: ugh. which toggle exactly? the new CUTLASS fallback or the arch probe?

olivia: we flipped `USE_CUTLASS=ON` for model-suite B and enabled arch-prober to prefer sm90 CUTLASS kernels.

olivia: profiler dump (short):
```
# timeline snippet
[0.00s] request queued
[0.03s] batch start (N=8)
[0.05s] load KV cache shard (gpu0) -- lock wait 1.9ms
[0.052s] cutlass GEMM launch
[0.09s] GEMM complete
[0.095s] KV apply (serialize) -- lock wait 2.5ms
[0.10s] send tokens
```

olivia: two lock waits per request path. NVTX shows lock contention during warm-up.

nate: interesting. i thought KV was per-GPU local. are we still funneling through the global kv manager?

mike: yes, after the change we have a single coordinator that does shard routing then grabs a mutex to merge hot prefixes. cheap for small qps but scales poorly with batching.

jisoo: can you paste the build flags we used for the sm90 CUTLASS build? maybe some atomic fence was introduced.

olivia: build flags: `cmake -DUSE_CUTLASS=ON -DARCH=90 -DCUTLASS_FAST_FMA=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo`

rahul: i wonder if the CUTLASS path has different stream synchronization semantics that expose our KV merge critical section. CUTLASS kernels sometimes block on RT streams.

sam: quick repro attempt: run 100 concurrent short-context requests with batching window 20ms and kv-hot pattern. i can run on a dev pool.

olivia: thanks. i pushed a lightweight patch to reduce KV merge scope to only keys missing from local shard. diff: `kv_manager::merge_if_missing(...)` instead of full copy. skipping full lock held during GEMM.

infra-bot: deploy request queued by sam for cluster dev-sm90-x2 (job id: deploy-5523).

nate: another angle: our batching heuristic pads sequences to multiples for CUTLASS alignment which increases KV lookups. maybe pad_to_multiple_of=8 causing extra reads.

mike: good catch. padding increases the effective token count so KV miss ratio spikes and we do more merges. try `pad_to_multiple_of=1` for FP8/4bit mixed routes.

jisoo: also run `nsys` on the failing run and dump kernel submission timeline. add `--trace=cuda,osrt` and grep for `cuLaunchKernel` gaps.

olivia: repro logs i collected: `nsys` shows 1.8ms gaps between launch and completion only on CUTLASS path, triton path is 0.3ms.

rahul: that suggests stream synchronization/blocking. maybe CUTLASS builds use cuda graph fallback or stream sync we didn't expect. we should test with `CUTLASS_DISABLE_STREAM_SYNC=1` env to see effect.

sam: i've started a run with `CUTLASS_DISABLE_STREAM_SYNC=1` + `pad_to_multiple_of=1` + local kv merge patch. will report in ~15m.

mike: if that helps, we should add a runtime guard: for mixed quant routes on ARCH>=90 prefer Triton path until we verify CUTLASS stream behavior. i can prototype a policy rule.

nate: can we also flip perf counters on the mutex? `perf record -e sched:task_wait` and `perf script` should show the contention source.

olivia: added trace: `perf record -F 997 -a -g -- sleep 30` and `perf script | c++filt` shows repeated `std::mutex::lock` in `kv_manager`. confirmed hotspots.

jisoo: from a model-quality lens, we can't change padding heuristics indiscriminately. needs A/B with quality diffs. but short-term route rerouting is fine.

rahul: also think about KV cache sharding strategy: make merges lock-free by using RCU-ish pointer swap for small deltas. lower-risk is to use per-batch local write buffer then apply with single atomic append.

sam: run finished: p90 down to baseline when both the env flag and patch applied. CUTLASS still slightly higher p50 by ~5% vs triton.

olivia: can we get a kernel flame/stack from `nsys` and the `nsight` UI? i'll attach to the ticket.

mike: plan: 1) revert arch-prober preference (hotfix), 2) land kv merge scope patch, 3) add runtime policy to prefer triton for mixed quant on sm90, 4) longer perf run with padding off and CUTLASS_DISABLE_STREAM_SYNC test.

nate: i'll open the rollback PR for the prober toggle and tag eng-runtime on it.

olivia: filing short postmortem in incidents once we confirm rollback. thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy success: rollback PR merged to staging (deploy-5523)

sam: follow-up: we should add a small unit test that simulates concurrent KV merges under heavy batch sizes to catch regressions in CI. i'll draft one.

jisoo: and add an eval run to ensure quality unchanged when we toggle padding heuristics.

olivia: best next steps documented in GH issue: link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/4123

mike: awesome. tagging this thread in the issue for trace snippets.

olivia: thanks everyone, closing the loop here.
